accepted.name: bounded aggregate
accepted.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM data

accepted.name: aggregate expression
accepted.sql: SELECT SUM("Price") AS total FROM data

accepted.name: local alias
accepted.sql: SELECT mine."Price" FROM data AS mine

accepted.name: nested lexical cte
accepted.sql: WITH source AS (SELECT "Price" FROM data) SELECT AVG("Price") FROM source

accepted.name: multiple ctes
accepted.sql: WITH first_source AS (SELECT "Price" FROM data), second_source AS (SELECT "Price" FROM data) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM first_source

accepted.name: union
accepted.sql: SELECT "Price" FROM data UNION ALL SELECT "Price" FROM data

accepted.name: cast
accepted.sql: SELECT CAST("Price" AS DOUBLE) FROM data

accepted.name: boolean expression
accepted.sql: SELECT "Price" FROM data WHERE "Price" IS NOT NULL AND "Price" > 0

rejected.name: private cte shadow
rejected.sql: WITH __maxun_sources AS (SELECT * FROM data) SELECT * FROM __maxun_sources

rejected.name: nested private cte shadow
rejected.sql: WITH outer_cte AS (WITH __maxun_manifest AS (SELECT * FROM data) SELECT * FROM __maxun_manifest) SELECT * FROM outer_cte

rejected.name: unknown qualifier
rejected.sql: SELECT unknown."Price" FROM data AS mine

rejected.name: derived relation
rejected.sql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM data) AS nested

rejected.name: recursive cte
rejected.sql: WITH RECURSIVE source AS (SELECT * FROM data) SELECT * FROM source

rejected.name: create

rejected.name: insert
